claim: Try it with sample data
where: Landing page primary action and /demo
sandbox: A fresh 390 px browser context opens /demo and sees a complete sample card before setup.

claim: Demo — sample data, nothing is saved to real extension data
where: /demo banner and README
sandbox: A fresh context resumes and resets the sample; only the demo:focus-resume-card key is used.

claim: Starting for real discards the demo sample state
where: /demo banner and sample explanation
sandbox: A fresh context resumes the sample, starts for real, then revisits /demo and sees a waiting sample with no demo storage key.

claim: The site loads no analytics, tracking, third-party scripts, fonts, or runtime CDNs
where: Landing footer, privacy page, and README
sandbox: A fresh demo flow records every request and requires all requests to stay same-origin.

claim: Card data stays in browser extension storage and is not sent over the network
where: Landing page, privacy page, extension, and README
sandbox: A clean installed MV3 profile writes a real card to chrome.storage.local, renders it, and records zero HTTP requests.

claim: A card keeps its saved page, optional title and selection, elapsed focus time, and next action
where: Landing page, privacy page, extension, and README
sandbox: A clean installed MV3 profile stores and renders every promised text field from one real extension card.

claim: A saved card remains available offline
where: Extension offline state and README
sandbox: A clean installed MV3 profile is taken offline before the popup loads; its stored card and offline state remain visible.

claim: Page title and selected text can be omitted from a saved card
where: Landing page, privacy page, extension, and README
sandbox: A real extension card with null title and selection renders 'Title hidden' and contains neither redacted value.

claim: A card can keep an optional screenshot locally
where: Landing page, privacy page, extension, and README
sandbox: A clean installed MV3 profile stores a data-URL screenshot on the card and renders that exact local image.

claim: Resume opens the exact saved page
where: Landing page, extension, and README
sandbox: The installed MV3 popup opens the stored URL including its query and fragment in a new page.

claim: Clearing a card requires confirmation and can be undone immediately
where: Extension and README
sandbox: The installed MV3 popup confirms clear, removes the storage record, then restores it through Undo.

claim: The next action must contain 5–12 words
where: Landing page, extension, privacy page, and README
sandbox: Unit boundaries accept exactly 5 and 12 words while rejecting 4 and 13 with exact recovery messages.

claim: The free card workflow requires no account
where: Landing page, privacy page, extension, and README
sandbox: A clean installed MV3 profile renders and uses a saved card without credentials or an account form.

claim: The quiet toolbar dot is optional and off by default
where: Landing page, settings, privacy page, and README
sandbox: A clean installed MV3 profile observes an empty badge by default and a dot only after the stored preference is enabled.

claim: The quiet toolbar dot uses no notifications, sounds, or schedules
where: Extension settings
sandbox: A clean installed MV3 profile checks the running manifest for no notification or alarm permission and confirms settings expose no audio or scheduled-control UI.

claim: A stored Plus license is verified at most once per day
where: Privacy page and README
sandbox: The installed settings page uses a fresh cached verdict without a request and makes one mocked gateway request after 24 hours.

claim: A valid Plus license enables Lichen and Night color treatments while the core card stays free
where: Landing page, settings, terms, and README
sandbox: The installed settings page starts with Plus choices disabled, unlocks from a recorded valid response, and persists Night.

claim: A revoked license disables Plus settings on this device
where: Extension settings and terms
sandbox: The installed settings page receives a recorded revoked license response, disables Plus controls, and resets paid preferences while the free card remains available.

claim: Clearing extension data removes the card, preferences, and license from this device
where: Extension settings and privacy page
sandbox: A clean installed MV3 profile creates every local record, confirms the clear action, and observes the card, preferences, license, and cached verdict removed.

claim: Screenshots are compressed during capture and stored locally
where: Extension capture form, privacy page, and README
sandbox: A clean installed MV3 profile captures a 1920 by 1080 fixture and observes a locally stored JPEG reduced to 960 by 540 pixels.

claim: The client honors a real 429 Retry-After response without blocking the free workflow
where: Website client, extension settings, and README
sandbox: Unit coverage parses delta and date Retry-After values and verifies the user-facing free-workflow fallback.

claim: Plus costs $9 once and checkout uses the Sociobot product endpoint
where: Landing page, settings, terms, and README
sandbox: The installed settings page shows the exact one-time price and links to the registered Sociobot checkout endpoint without opening it.

claim: The download is an installable Manifest V3 extension package
where: Landing page and README
test: npm run build && npm run test:artifact -- --grep @claim:download-package
sandbox: A clean build opens the packaged ZIP, checks fixed archive dates and required MV3 files, and validates its deployment MIME rule.
